import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    df = sns.load_dataset('titanic')

# --- Visualization ---
# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create a figure and axes for the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create the violin plot combined with a swarm plot
sns.violinplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='age',
    hue='survived',
    split=True,
    inner='quart',
    palette={0: "#d9534f", 1: "#5cb85c"},
    ax=ax,
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)

sns.swarmplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='age',
    hue='survived',
    dodge=True,
    size=2,
    color=".25",
    ax=ax,
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)

# --- Customization and Labeling ---
# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Survival Distribution by Age and Passenger Class', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Age', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)

# Customize the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
# The swarmplot adds extra legend handles, so we only take the first two from the violinplot
ax.legend(
    handles[0:2],
    ['Did not survive', 'Survived'],
    title='Survival Status',
    loc='upper left',
    frameon=True,
    shadow=True,
    fontsize=12,
    title_fontsize=13
)

# Improve tick label formatting
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%d'))

# Add a grid for better readability
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='', alpha=0) # Turn off vertical grid lines

# Adjust layout
fig.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
